open_scientific_decision_against_my_own_.what: BATCH_20260913_003 propagated a correction to DL-MECH-012 that KEPT the entry's direction and retired only the count as a strength argument. scientist-c's reading of the lung leg (ALDAZ-FT-C-003, commits 066b476, 2e71f1a, cb5d369) shows the direction itself now needs qualifying.
open_scientific_decision_against_my_own_.the_finding: DL-MECH-012 names three legs — 36828035, 39868255, 38563965 — and PMID 33058734 is NOT among them. That unlisted fourth leg is peer-reviewed, same laboratory, same endothelial knockout, same tissue, and it carries the NULL: it measures lung inflammation twice and does not find it (no significance mark on twelve bars across two figures, verified at 600 dpi; both legend titles state the negative; the authors conclude an inflammation-INDEPENDENT mechanism; the one pathway interrogated was inhibited and did not rescue). So the entry's 'direzione univoca' is univocal partly because the negative leg is unlisted.
open_scientific_decision_against_my_own_.what_the_read_leg_actually_adds: Not a third independent confirmation. A STIMULUS BOUNDARY — mechanical yes, infectious no — plus a selective intervention (dual silencing cuts IL-8 by 35% and leaves IL-6 ns), a named upstream node, and a MAPK direction correction (ERK and JNK up, p38 DOWN). Power and stimulus change together across the pair and cannot be separated by it.
open_scientific_decision_against_my_own_.the_revival_trigger_i_wrote_is_answered: The compartment-boundary paragraph I propagated set a REVIVAL_TRIGGER: read 38563965 and record its system, species and whether basal endothelial WWOX is detectable. Answer: cultured human pulmonary artery endothelial cells plus FACS-sorted mouse lung endothelium plus whole-animal VILI; human and mouse; and basal endothelial WWOX IS detectable by two independent methods. So the PREMISE: DEFAULT_FROM_TEXTBOOK dissolves, and the atlas finding and the knockdown phenotype are COMPATIBLE, NOT RECONCILED — capillary in fixed tissue versus artery in culture. Whether human capillary endothelium in situ expresses WWOX is left open.
open_scientific_decision_against_my_own_.status: OPEN — not propagated, not closed here, and deliberately not rewritten as a new synthesis. It rests on a reading that has NOT yet been independently verified; the packets for that verification are prepared and USABLE, and the pass is dispatched when a verifier frees. Only then may a second BATCH_COMMIT touch this entry.

The lesson is narrow and real: quoting a privacy check's message verbatim into a tracked record can reproduce the very pattern the check exists to catch.

corrections_against_the_orchestrator_its.what: I recorded, in this file and in the checkpoint, that scientist-c's lung leg showed DL-MECH-012's DIRECTION needed qualifying because the unlisted fourth leg 'measures lung inflammation twice and does not find it'.

That paper measures inflammatory output a THIRD time, in endothelial cells sorted from the same animals, and FINDS IT SIGNIFICANT on all three analytes. The producer recorded this in its own locators and dossier; my brief and my record omitted it.
corrections_against_the_orchestrator_its.the_correct_framing: The qualification is COMPARTMENT- AND STIMULUS-BOUNDED, not a reversal of direction: BAL-level inflammation is not found under infectious challenge, while endothelial-compartment inflammation in the same animals is. And a non-significant n=3 comparison with overlapping error bars is NOT a demonstrated null — which is the same discipline this batch applied to the microglial-abundance arm of CLAIM 006 and which I failed to apply to my own summary.
corrections_against_the_orchestrator_its.consequence: The second BATCH_COMMIT must propagate the BOUNDED qualification, not mine. The verification also found the three narrowings in that lot were all UNDERSTATEMENTS — 24 unmarked bars across the pair rather than the twelve stated — so the producer under-claimed and I over-generalised in opposite directions on the same figures.

corrections_against_the_orchestrator_its.what: STRUCTURAL, and a verifier found it about my practice rather than about a document: my commit subjects carry conclusions, and `git log` subjects stated the W4 objects' conclusions before that verifier opened its packet, so its blinding was partial.
corrections_against_the_orchestrator_its.why_it_matters: The verification packet exists to let a pass form expectations from sources before meeting a producer's verdict. A commit subject that names the verdict defeats that firewall from outside the packet, and no packet check can see it. The actor declared the exposure itself rather than letting it pass silently, which is the only reason it is known.
corrections_against_the_orchestrator_its.what_i_did_about_it_and_what_i_could_not: I could not retroactively remove it: the subjects are in history. For the W5 dispatch I told the actor the exposure exists, that it is mine and not its own, and to declare explicitly which expectations were formed before and after reading them. What I have NOT done is change the practice, because a commit message that hides what a commit contains is worse than one that spoils a firewall — the honest fix is a packet whose firewall does not depend on my prose, and that is a harness change outside this mandate. Recorded as a real limitation of this batch's blinding, not as a solved problem.
